name: Prompt_injection_benchmark_08-11-2025
description: A collection of adversarial prompts and scenarios designed to measure model susceptibility to prompt‑injection attacks. It evaluates whether models follow or resist malicious instructions across varied injection strategies and trigger patterns. Used to benchmark defenses and robustness of text generation models to instruction‑based exploits.
reputation: Emerging dataset used by safety researchers and practitioners; not yet broadly adopted across the wider NLP community.
